nodes.label: Drive appDataFolder Storage
nodes.rationale: Private isolated app storage invisible in standard Drive UI, ensuring zero server cost and user data privacy

nodes.label: Base Revision Conflict Detection
nodes.rationale: Comparing local updatedAt vs server modifiedTime is not enough to distinguish changes; requires base revision tracking with fileId, lastSyncedServerModifiedTime, and lastSyncedLocalUpdatedAt

nodes.label: Multi-tab Concurrency Lock
nodes.rationale: Guards concurrent tabs on same device using navigator.locks to prevent racing cloud uploads

nodes.label: Immediate Local Persistence
nodes.rationale: Flush SRAM and save states to IndexedDB immediately on visibilitychange and pagehide rather than waiting for 3s debounce

nodes.label: Silent Token Renewal
nodes.rationale: Use prompt: 'none' in GIS for silent renewal to avoid consent popup loops, falling back to user gesture on error
